title: Variance of Conditional Treatment Effects with Latent Ability Measured by Repeated Assessments
banked_reason: D0.5.G incremental ceiling 6.2 below field floor 7.4, salvageable=false; independent main validity confirms no material tier-lifting route. Math and citations pass only for enlarged-class derivation; unresolved frozen-kernel substitution findings explicitly retained.
gap_reasons: The theorem proves a different point-risk problem: its rule class permits outputs in [0,1], whereas the promised class restricts estimators to [0,1/4], despite legal laws with V=1/3.
The theorem replaces the requested [0,1/4]-contained honest intervals by intervals in [0,1]; because a legal law has V=1/3, it does not deliver the stated length problem.

The assertion that all four requested frontiers are proved on the 'complete frozen class' is inaccurate: def:complete-model drops the requested outcome-mean bounds [1/4,3/4], and the procedure classes permit outputs in [0,1]. The claimed legal counterexample with V=1/3 therefore violates the brief, and the delivered selectors are not literally admissible under its output contract. Restricting the upper theorem and clipping its procedures restores the requested rates without new statistical arguments, because the matching lower alternatives already satisfy the original outcome bounds. The logarithmic recovery scale already appears in [Capitao-Miniconi, Gassiat, and Lehéricy](https://www.imo.universite-paris-saclay.fr/~elisabeth.gassiat/repeated.pdf); the additional contribution is the endpoint-inclusive marked-ratio modulus and matching VCATE risk, honest-length, and disclosure results. The enormous dictionary construction supplies existence without demonstrated usable precision, while the prospective application and approximately 0.26% Gaussian variance comparison with fixed latent density do not establish broader practical significance. These limitations and the false frozen-class framing constrain the projected paper score despite the delivered matching rate arguments. proof_attempt_summary: Discovery discharged informal matching VCATE risk, honest-length and disclosed-channel orders, with six cited sources verified and attested; the math review passed for the enlarged class. The typed decision review failed the original kernel because outcome margins and procedure ranges were enlarged, while the independent general review rated the package incremental at ceiling 6.2 below the field floor 7.4. Independent main validity found restoration of the margins and clipping mathematically routine but not tier-lifting; that repair remains unapplied, and no Lean formalization was launched.
tldr: Baseline ability can explain dispersion in treatment benefits, but repeated assessments leave ability latent and their measurement channels unknown. On the complete class \(\mathcal M_s\), minimax absolute risk and shortest globally honest connected confidence intervals have the common sharp order \([1+\log n/\log(\mathrm e+\log n)]^{-2s}\), for both blind and disclosed channels on the identical original records. Total finite selectors attain the bounds and fixed-channel full-record alternatives give the all-procedure converses, including outcome-boundary and homogeneous-effect laws. Disclosure has no worst-class order effect. A separate regular Gaussian submodel certifies a local blind/disclosed asymptotic variance ratio in \( (1.002588,1.002602)\); this is a local constant information price, not a global worst-class constant comparison. A prospective masked baseline-assessment protocol motivates conditional nondifferential measurement of realized treatment and outcome marks without independence from unobserved counterfactuals.
gap: Unknown-repeat density recovery and inverse quadratic-functional estimation leave a gap at a causal ratio functional with four jointly calibrated nonnegative marks and endpoint-positive interval densities. Observed-covariate VCATE inference does not determine finite-sample precision when latent ability must be recovered and outcome probabilities may attain their boundaries.
fill: The frontier questions use the same boundary-inclusive primitive model for blind and disclosed experiments and require exact risk and globally honest length orders, total computations, and all-procedure converses. Arm-denominator stability permits zero marked cells; finite primitive dictionaries and full-record positive lower submodels provide the handles. A profiled Gaussian variance-score calculation isolates a possible local information cost without assuming a worst-class calibration price.
